title: Sean Payton trying to find ways to get Marvin Mims Jr. more opportunities

sources.title: Sean Payton trying to find ways to get Marvin Mims Jr. more opportunities
sources.description: It’s another season and another slow start for Marvin Mims Jr. in the Denver Broncos offense. The strange usage early on in seasons seems to be a recurring theme and something head coach Sean Payton mentions about this time every year of getting more touches to Mims. He did so again on Monday. “We’re trying […]
